stem.text: Four students were asked to suggest a set of four labels to add to a plan diagram of a transverse section of a dicotyledonous leaf.
Which student suggested a correct set of labels?

A.text: lower epidermis; phloem; spongy mesophyll; palisade mesophyll

B.text: phloem sieve tubes; upper epidermis; spongy mesophyll; xylem vessel elements

C.text: spongy mesophyll; endodermis; xylem vessel elements; palisade mesophyll

D.text: waxy cuticle; xylem; companion cells; spongy mesophyll
